title: Culling of Free-roaming Chickens at Sin Ming
what_it_is: Culling of Free-roaming Chickens at Sin Ming

sections.label: Sin Ming free-roaming chickens bird flu
sections.summary: AVA found Sin Ming free-roaming chickens more than doubled to 50 and cites bird flu risk to justify managing the population.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In the case of free-roaming chickens near Sin Ming Avenue, AVA found that the population had more than doubled to 50 birds.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Studies have shown that chickens are more susceptible to the bird flu virus, compared to other birds like pigeons.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In other words, there is a higher risk of free-roaming chickens being exposed and infected with bird flu from migratory wild birds, which are often reservoirs for the bird flu virus.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: There is also scientific evidence that chickens can, in turn, transmit the disease to humans, creating a zoonotic disease.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fact, the World Health Organization (WHO) reported that the majority of human cases of bird flu infection have been associated with contact with infected live or dead poultry, including chickens.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: That is why AVA felt that it had to take action to manage the chicken population in Sin Ming.

sections.label: Culling as last resort
sections.summary: Culling will only be done as the very last resort.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Culling will only be done as the very last resort.

sections.label: Feedback from Sin Ming residents
sections.summary: AVA received more than 20 feedback from residents near Thomson View and Sin Ming Avenue blocks in 2015 and 2016, versus six in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In 2015 and 2016, AVA received more than 20 feedback from various residents living in the vicinity of Thomson View and Blocks 452 to 454 in Sin Ming Avenue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This is in contrast to the six feedback that have been received in the year before, in 2014.

sections.label: Chicken numbers grew
sections.summary: The number of chickens grew from about 20 in 2014 to more than 50 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The number of chickens had grown from about 20 in 2014, to more than 50 in 2016.

sections.label: AVA removed free-roaming chickens
sections.summary: AVA removed over 20 free-roaming chickens, more than 60% of which were roosters that created noise nuisance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: AVA, thus, removed over 20 free-roaming chickens, of which more than 60% are roosters which created some of the noise nuisance as well.

sections.label: EU decision on avian influenza
sections.summary: The EU made a decision dated 14 February 2017 on transmission of highly pathogenic avian influenza from wild birds to poultry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The EU actually has made a decision dated 14 February 2017, just recently, on the transmission of highly pathogenic avian influenza from wild birds to poultry.

sections.label: Chicken rehoming and zoonotic risk
sections.summary: Rehoming chickens in HDB flats is not possible, and zoonotic risk between cats, dogs and chickens is far apart.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In certain situations where there are suitable rehoming options, we will explore that as one approach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But having said that, rehoming chickens in Housing and Development Board (HDB) flats is not possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In any case, the zoonotic risk between a cat, dog and a chicken is quite far apart.

sections.label: AVA NUS urban bird study
sections.summary: AVA is working with NUS on a two-year urban bird research study that began in January last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: AVA is also working with NUS on a two-year urban bird research study which began in January last year.

sections.label: Chicken culling numbers
sections.summary: 24 chickens have been culled, with 26 remaining.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Second, so, we have culled 24 chickens, there are 26 remaining.
